q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password." We will email you a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. For more details, please visit our pricing page.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 users, it's $40 per month. Would you like to open a support ticket for more details?

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the free plan. For more details, see the "Which plans are there?" section in the FAQ.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: You can get a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, you cannot get a refund after 14 days. Please contact support if you have any concerns.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Sorry, there is no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app. If you need further help, I can open a support ticket for you.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Sorry, Example Notes does not support Android 11. We recommend updating to Android 12 or later.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, the web app needs an internet connection. For offline access, use the mobile or desktop app.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export everything as PDF, go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, but Example Notes does not support SMS for two-factor authentication. You need to use an authenticator app.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum file size for attachments on the free plan is 25 MB.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of the current billing period. For more details, visit Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. If you need more information, please open a support ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don't hear back, please resend your query.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans. For more details, visit the pricing page.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use up to 3 devices with the Plus plan.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket to ask about student discounts.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for more details.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, but we don't know how to import notes from Evernote. You might want to open a support ticket for this request.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. Please open a support ticket for more details.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, I can't provide code examples. If you need help with using Example Notes, feel free to ask! Otherwise, I recommend visiting a site like Stack Overflow for coding help.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, I don't know the weather information. This is unrelated to Example Notes.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: If you forgot your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry to hear about your experience. If you deleted notes, they stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". If you don't see this option, you might need to open a support ticket.
